incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service 'hosted-inference-prod' (sev: high) — Incident PD-84291
incident-bot: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-84291|PD-84291> triggered by metric: p99_latency > 1200ms for 3m, error-rate spike to 3.2%
sam: acked via PD mobile (attempt) — looking into graphs, grabbing logs
mike: @sam ping — are you able to join the bridge? i'm reachable if you need immediate handoff :phone:
sam: I'm on it, pulling recent dashboards now
sam: ```
# quick check
curl -s 'https://grafana.internal/render?query=svc.hosted-inference.errors' | jq .data
# spike around 2026-03-11T15:12 UTC, 503s up
```
alex: I can see node gpu-12 with memory pressure and container restarts (OOM kills)
mike: note: PD will escalate to secondary in ~2m if primary doesn't ack in PD
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: primary did not acknowledge within configured window — paging secondary: mike
mike: mobile push isn't coming through for me :confused: trying web ack now
jen: I received manager page as well — ping me if it escalates to manager bridge, I can join immediately
mike: acked on web at 1887654510 — joining bridge: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-84291|PD-84291>
sam: quick mitigation suggestion: cordon+drain gpu-12 and restart inference pod instance to clear OOM state
sam: ```
# drain node
kubectl cordon gpu-12 && kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
# restart service
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime
```
alex: logs show oom_kill: "Killed process 3742 (infer-runner) total-vm:..." and eviction notices around 15:11:52
mike: initiating rolling restart of nodes in pool now, will stagger to keep capacity
sam: watching token latency - p50 ok, p99 coming down after first restart (30s)
mike: bridge note: temporary 503s observed for ~3 minutes during node restart; we've mitigated and traffic is back to normal
jen: customer impact summary please for post-incident note?
mike: short summary: transient 5xx spike ~3 mins, estimated ~1.2k requests affected, mostly short-lived inference requests; no persisted data loss, no downstream SLA breach reported yet
sam: creating incident ticket and timeline, will add logs and commands run. assigning follow-up to infra team to investigate OOM root cause
jen: action items: 1) verify kernel OOM tuning on gpu nodes; 2) check autoscaler behavior under sudden memory pressure; 3) adjust PD mobile push retry diagnostics
mike: handing ownership back to sam for the detailed follow-up. I'll remain on-call for 15m for any regressions
sam: acknowledged handoff — creating INF ticket now and will add timeline + customer impact estimates
incident-bot: Incident PD-84291 status updated: acknowledged by mike; assigned to oncall sam; bridge created
mike: :thumbsup:
sam: follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1287 — adding timeline and attaching logs
alex: leaving a runbook note about observed OOM pattern on gpu-12 (evictions + infer-runner memory leak hypothesis)
jen: thanks all — PD escalation path behaved as configured but mobile push was flaky. we should consider increasing secondary timeout or improving push diagnostics. i'll add to PM backlog
mike: noted, staying nearby for 10m
sam: will update once postmortem draft is ready
